Polygonal layer of sidewalks in Boston

Source: R/data.R
boston_sidewalk.Rd

A SpatialLinesDataFrame object representing sidewalks in Central Boston.

boston_sidewalk

Format

A SpatialLinesDataFrame with 78 features.
